author: Gene Holcombe
text: You should go back to finger sticks. They are not defective. You have to learn how to use them properly.  Did you ever get training?

author: Rick Fritz
text: Call me crazy, but this is definitely not my experience with L3P.  I may have had 1 sensor go awry, but with reasonable expectations that CGM technology is not perfect and a convenience consumer product.  If you don’t like it, go back to finger sticks.
